name: Incline Push-Up
equipment: A sturdy elevated surface (or skip and do a regular push-up)
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy elevated surface (a step, low table, or bench). Place hands on the edge, slightly wider than shoulder width.
Position your feet back from the surface with arms and body straight, arms perpendicular to your body.
Keeping your body straight, lower your chest to the edge of the surface by bending your arms, then push back up until arms are extended. Repeat.
